headline: EXPLAINER: Things to know about Enugu’s proposed 2% rent cap
summary: The Enugu State House of Assembly has passed a bill that would restrict landlords from raising rents by more than two per cent every four years. The proposal could significantly change the local rental market.
why: Rent controls set legal limits on rental income, which can reduce returns for property owners and affect investment in residential real estate. Enugu is a state capital in southeastern Nigeria.
